title: Determine and review worker status
summary: Separately reviewed employment-rights and tax-status determinations with approved engagement changes and a reassessment record.
outcomes: Separately reviewed employment-rights and tax-status determinations with approved engagement changes and a reassessment record.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before engaging a worker, renewing an arrangement or materially changing the actual working relationship.

parts.title: Record the real working arrangement
parts.guidance: Collect the engaging entity, worker and work locations, intermediary, proposed duties, supervision, substitution, equipment, payment and actual working practices. Use private evidence from both parties; a contract label alone is insufficient input for a status decision.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

parts.title: Review employment and tax status separately
parts.guidance: Appropriately qualified employment and tax reviewers assess the relationship under the applicable local tests, recording their reasoning and unresolved facts. Employment-rights status and tax status may differ; agency, intermediary, overseas and disputed cases need the relevant specialist route.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

approval.scope: Review employment and tax status separately

parts.title: Prepare the engagement and correction plan
parts.guidance: Translate the reviewed determinations into proposed contract, onboarding, payroll, benefits and record changes. Identify historical arrangements needing correction and list affected owners without treating a draft contract as proof of the actual relationship.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

parts.title: Approve the determination and engagement route
parts.guidance: The accountable people owner approves the specific engagement or remediation plan after required employment and tax review. Resolve material factual disputes or missing locations before onboarding; retain the decision and its stated assumptions.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

approval.scope: Approve the determination and engagement route

parts.title: Implement the authorized engagement changes
parts.guidance: Authorized people complete the approved contracts, payroll or supplier setup and required communications in private systems. Retain signed records and implementation evidence, and assign disputed status or historical corrections to the qualified owner.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

parts.title: Verify actual practices and schedule reassessment
parts.guidance: Check that working practices and operating records reflect the approved arrangement. Record changes to location, control, duties or intermediary and reopen the assessment when assumptions change; preserve the separate employment and tax reasoning.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

verify.how: Separately reviewed employment-rights and tax-status determinations with approved engagement changes and a reassessment record.

notes.text: Editorial status: operational draft. Source checked on 2026-11-01. No case-specific legal review, independent professional assurance or completed execution is claimed. Sources establish regional entry points; determine the actual applicable local route with qualified reviewers.

metadata.supportReason: An agent can prepare and reconcile the documented inputs. Named people retain decisions, specialist judgments, physical work and authorized external actions.
